'''Shalu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as a quartermaster during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the conflict, she worked selling equipment in the supplies section on board the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]], which was located within the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]]. Shalu wore [[Color/Legends|white]] and black [[Armor/Legends|armor]] including a mask, and alsocarried a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. The Chiss had blue skin and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shalu was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game she serves as an Imperial classic gear vendor within the Imperial fleet. She was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
